tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure a seamless user experience. This includes determining the authentication method and user session management. The definition should be detailed enough to guide the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are redirected to the dashboard.

tasks.description: Identify and document the different types of reports that will be available in the customer portal. This includes determining the data sources and any specific requirements for each report type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then they can view a list of available report types.

tasks.description: Define the notification settings that will be available to users in the customer portal. This includes determining the types of notifications and how users can customize their notification preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the notification settings, then they can view and customize their notification preferences.

tasks.description: Write a detailed background section for the customer portal document. This should provide context and an overview of the project's goals and objectives.
acceptance_criteria: Given the document, when a reader views the background section, then they can understand the project's context and goals.

tasks.description: Define the acceptance criteria for the customer portal project. This includes determining the key performance indicators and user experience metrics that will be used to measure the project's success.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they use the customer portal, then they can complete their tasks efficiently and effectively.
